status: Illustrative inputs only; no market prices verified; no user financial data

formulas.cloth: initial stash + covers + replacements + wash loads/week*52*cost/load + detergent + drying + caregiver time (optional) - resale
formulas.hybrid: disposable units/day*365*unit price + cloth system expenses
formulas.formula: daily prepared volume * verified cost/prepared volume * days; avoid assuming feeding volume or altering dilution
formulas.breastfeeding: pump, supplies, lactation visits, time and any lost wages; not zero-cost by assumption

constraints: Cost models must not select feeding amounts, delay changing diapers, or rank clinical safety. Actual label/model/price/recall and household utility data needed.
